results.content: Q2 2026 results were mixed. Adjusted EPS came in at $0.33 versus the $0.5367 consensus estimate, a 38.51% miss, while revenue of $28.24 billion beat by 7.10% and grew 25.52% year over year. Free cash flow turned negative at –$1.09 billion as capital spending surged 141.81% to $5.79 billion, and operating margin compressed to 1.4%. Musk guided that “CapEx for this year will be more than $25 billion” and rising further.
